task: melanoma versus selected benign dermoscopic lesions

ham10000.version: Original 2018 data descriptor; the linked live archive collection may contain later additions
ham10000.redistribution: Non-commercial use with attribution; no images or metadata redistributed here.
ham10000.label_provenance: Histopathology for over half of lesions; the rest use follow-up, expert consensus, or confocal microscopy as described by the source paper.
ham10000.grouping_field: lesion_id; no patient ID is inferred
ham10000.acquisition_population: Historical pigmented-lesion samples from the Medical University of Vienna and a skin cancer office in Australia; not a general screening population.

isic2018_task3.license: CC-BY-NC, as stated in the local metadata and challenge data page
isic2018_task3.redistribution: Non-commercial use with attribution; no images or metadata redistributed here.
isic2018_task3.label_provenance: Source metadata diagnosis hierarchy and confirmation type; confirmation methods differ across lesions.
isic2018_task3.grouping_field: lesion_id; the archive collection lists no patient IDs
isic2018_task3.acquisition_population: Historical pigmented-lesion samples in the HAM10000-associated ISIC 2018 training collection; not a general screening population.
isic2018_task3.local_match_basis: The local export has 10,015 rows and 7,470 lesion IDs, matching the 2018 Task 3 collection. It has eight diagnosis hierarchy tuples, including separate SCC and solar/actinic keratosis entries; the original HAM metadata uses seven dx groups. Attribution and CC-BY-NC terms also match. No original download receipt, provider checksum, or full collection ID comparison was available.
